tonight.headline: Tuten missed Thursday — and he is still in a slot nobody can cover
body: Bad news first: Tuten did not practise Thursday after a limited Wednesday (Jaguars report on Giants.com, 19 Nov 16:00 ET; NBC 21:16Z). The lineup still has him in an RB slot, Diggs in FLEX and Gordon on the bench, so if Jacksonville declare him inactive at 13:55 Sunday, every back you could swap in has locked at 12:00. One move fixes it (Do-first), and it is the projection lineup anyway.

Fairbairn kicks first, tonight at 19:15: Houston have ruled out Marks and Harrison Jr. and get Montgomery back (SI Texans final report). Waddle has cleared the concussion protocol (SI Broncos, 19 Nov), so after the fix he and Diggs are both live fallbacks for Tuten. ESPN projects 136.1 to 128.2 and gives you 54%.

case.label: The script that beats you
case.body: Prescott (22.3), Javonte Williams (19.7) and Pickens (15.8) all play Tennessee at 12:00 — ESPN's highest projected total of the week at 59.4 (ESPN Playbook 19 Nov). One Cowboys shootout moves three of Panda Attack's starters at once (league file).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Tuten inactive with no live fallback — 17.0 projected points to zero. After Thursday's DNP that is no longer a remote case. The Do-first card is the fix and costs nothing.

case.label: The problem
case.body: As set at the 22:05Z snapshot, Tuten sits in an RB slot and every back on your bench plays at 12:00 (Gordon at Buffalo, Etienne at Chicago). Jacksonville–New York kicks off at 15:25; inactives come at 13:55, after both have locked.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: Tuten went from limited Wednesday to did-not-practise Thursday (Jaguars report, Giants.com 19 Nov; CBS/RotoWire 16:24 ET). He was seen working off to the side; CBS says it 'may be routine maintenance'. Last week he sat two practices and took 29 touches, so he may well play — but a downward practice trend is real news ESPN's 17.0 has not priced.

case.label: The fallbacks
case.body: Waddle was a full participant Wednesday and has cleared the concussion protocol (SI Broncos 19 Nov 00:43Z); Denver play Las Vegas at 15:25. Diggs was a rest-day DNP on Washington's first report (Commanders.com 19 Nov) and plays Monday. Both are still unlocked at 13:55 — but only for a FLEX slot.

case.label: The fix
case.body: Gordon (13.9) into an RB slot, Tuten (17.0) into FLEX, Diggs (13.0) to the bench. That is the lineup check's projection lineup — Gordon over Diggs is a 0.9 coin flip, taken by rule.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Tuten is inactive and the slot still scores zero because the swap was not made before 12:00. The Gordon-over-Diggs choice inside it is a coin flip and is not graded as a thesis.
